author: Ari Koslow
title: Clay Holmes (fibula) to throw live BP Saturday
desc: Clay Holmes is expected to throw live batting practice on Saturday.
impact: Holmes was originally expected to make a rehab start, but he is now expected to throw live BP due to rain. He could be activated during the last week of July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Aaron Judge (rib) transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Yankees transferred Aaron Judge to the 60-day injured list.
impact: Judge remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bradley Hanner agrees to deal with Yankees, optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Yankees signed RHP Bradley Hanner to a major league contract and optioned him to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre.
impact: Hanner will add relief depth in Triple-A for the Yankees.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Brandon Woodruff to undergo shoulder surgery
desc: Brandon Woodruff will undergo shoulder surgery "with the goal in mind of pitching again."
impact: Woodruff will have a capsule surgery on his shoulder, the same procedure he had in 2023. An exact timeline for return is not available yet. The right-hander has been on the injured list since July 5th and has struggled to stay on the field in recent years, throwing just 177 total innings since the beginning of the 2023 season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emiliano Teodo optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Rangers optioned Emiliano Teodo to Triple-A.
impact: Teodo returns to Triple-A with Jose Corniell recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Corniell recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Rangers recalled Jose Corniell from Triple-A Round Rock.
impact: Corniell will return to a middle-relief role. He has made one appearance in the majors this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gavin Collyer optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Rangers optioned Gavin Collyer to Triple-A Round Rock.
impact: Collyer returns to Triple-A with Jakob Junis activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jakob Junis (hip) activated from IL
desc: The Rangers activated Jakob Junis from the injured list.
impact: Junis returns after a short stint on the injured list. Gavin Collyer was optioned to Triple-A as the corresponding move.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Carson Benge steals base in win over Phillies
desc: Carson Benge went 1-for-4 in Thursday's win over the Phillies with one stolen base.
impact: Benge continues a dynamic stretch of late, getting on base in 23 of his last 25 contests. The outfielder continues to reward fantasy managers as one of the few impactful options in a disappointing Mets lineup, batting .263 with 11 home runs, 32 RBI, 52 runs scored, and 16 stolen bases through 95 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brett Baty goes yard in win over Phillies
desc: Brett Baty went 2-for-4 in a win over the Phillies with a solo home run.
impact: Baty continues a torrid stretch of late, reaching base in 11 of his last 12 contests. The infielder remains one of the more underwhelming options in an underperforming Mets lineup to this point, hitting .224 with five home runs, 32 RBI, 36 runs scored, and five stolen bases through 94 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Francisco Alvarez goes deep twice in win over Phillies
desc: Francisco Alvarez went 2-for-3 in Thursday's win over the Phillies with two solo home runs and one walk.
impact: Alvarez continues a productive stretch at the plate of late, driving in runs in four of his last six contests. The catcher remains one of many inconsistent bats in the Mets lineup for manager Andy Green, slashing .259 with 11 home runs, 24 RBI, and 21 runs scored through 65 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Devin Williams shuts door in win over Phillies
desc: Devin Williams struck out one batter in one scoreless frame to earn the save in Thursday's win over the Phillies.
impact: Williams continues a steady stretch out of the bullpen, holding opponents scoreless in five of his last eight contests. The right-hander continues to take fantasy managers on a roller-coaster ride as the primary closing option in an inconsistent Mets bullpen to this point, posting a 4.68 ERA and 1.65 WHIP with a 3-2 record, 14 saves, and a 12.4 K/9 ratio through 36 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Christian Scott cruises on mound in win over Phillies
desc: Christian Scott allowed three hits while striking out seven over 5 2/3 scoreless innings in Thursday's 4-1 win over the Phillies.
impact: Scott continues a solid stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in four of his last six contests. The right-hander has offered manager Andy Green one of the more stable options as part of an inconsistent Mets rotation, carrying a 2.87 ERA and 1.22 WHIP with a 3-1 record and 10.9 K/9 ratio through 13 starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Miguel Vargas (hand) in lineup Saturday
desc: Miguel Vargas is back in the White Sox lineup on Saturday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Vargas avoids a scare following his exit late in Friday's series opener. He is back at third base and hitting third.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blake Perkins recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Brewers recalled OF Blake Perkins from Triple-A Nashville.
impact: Perkins returns to the majors in a depth role with Sal Frelick placed on the injured list.
